title: NEW MINT-IN-BOX 1915 CHEVROLET FIVE PASSENGER BABY GRAND NATIONAL MOTOR MUSEUM
descriptionText: The product is a highly detailed 1:64 scale model of a 1915 Chevrolet Five Passenger Baby Grand, made by National Motor Museum Mint in China. This collectible piece is a replica of the iconic vehicle and is considered a rare find for enthusiasts of vintage automobiles. With the brand's reputation for quality and authenticity, this mint-in-box model is a valuable addition to any collection of automotive memorabilia.
